11.titre: U1·Seq2 — Reading: an e-mail from Finland (résumé original, p.21)
lignes: An e-mail from Kirsi, a sixteen-year-old Finnish girl.
She introduces herself and asks about Amel's country.
On weekdays she gets up early and goes to school by bus.
She has classes in the morning and in the afternoon.
She rarely goes out at the weekend.
Her family has a dog and a parrot.
She lives in a small village called Tikkakoski, in Central Finland.
Finland is famous for its saunas and lakes.
